source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Read the report (if the results are available):
    * Read the entire report without trying to understand everything or
      remember it all.
    * If necessary, read the report a second time to understand what was
      done and to see if there were any mistakes in how the testing was
      or was not done.
    * See if there is anything in the report that can explain what
      happened or that makes sense of anything that the report states.
    * If there are photos at the end of the report, look at them as well
      (they may or may not be available).
3. Look at the laboratory results:
    * Find the results of the failed tests.
    * Look at the column on the very right -- that tells whether the
      water samples passed or failed. If they failed, what did they
      fail?
    * See https://epa.oh
